title: Appointed as Assistant
original: Here are the files, and this is your coffee. No need to thank me.

title: Talk 1
original: Yes…? Oh! Sorry Doctor, I thought an operator was calling out to me.

title: Talk 2
original: If you can hold a scalpel, you can hold a gun. Never doubt the steadiness of a surgeon's hand.

title: Talk 3
original: Neither sickness nor the enemy can take from me what I want to protect.

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: When you have walked with death, you learn to appreciate life.

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: I've learned from experience that the place to save lives is in the field, not an office. And sometimes, the only way to save a life is to take one.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: My job is to keep you alive. Make it as hard as you like.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: Not a fan of your worried face. What's the matter?

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: Doctor. I'm so glad we found you.

title: Idle
original: When was the last time you took a break? You need to stop working.

title: Onboard
original: Code name Doc, Team Rainbow. I'll protect you.

title: Watching Battle Record
original: This will make things easier.

title: Promotion 1
original: If we must, we must.

title: Promotion 2
original: Thank you, I'd been hoping to get authorization to access confidential files on Oripathy.

title: Added to Squad
original: Call if you need a hand.

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: Let's be safe out there.

title: Depart
original: At least we are well prepared.

title: Begin Operation
original: There are still active targets in the area.

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: Ready to go.

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: I've got your backs.

title: Deployment 1
original: Get going quickly.

title: Deployment 2
original: Try not to get yourselves hurt.

title: In Battle 1
original: Located target.

title: In Battle 2
original: Target acquired.

title: In Battle 3
original: Stick close to me.

title: In Battle 4
original: Reloading!

title: 4-star Result
original: Are you alright? Any difficulty breathing?

title: 3-star Result
original: We're almost at the extraction point. Then, we can rest.

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: Let's get you back on your feet, shall we?

title: Operation Failure
original: We're wasting time.

title: Assigned to Facility
original: Always a pleasure.

title: Tap
original: Careful, I'm carrying a bunch of bric-a-bracs.

title: Trust Tap
original: Nothing abnormal. If we get a situation, I'll let you know.

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: Greeting
original: Bonjour.
